item.tib: byams ma sngags lugs rgyud sde rgya mtsho phyag gi kha skangs dad pa'i pad dkar 'bum ldan
item.coloph: rab 'byams dkyil 'khor brgya rtsis (rtsa'i) phyag bstod 'di/ rab ming mkhan zur nyi ri shel bzhin gyis/ rab sngon baiDUr zhun ma 'khyil 'dra yi/ rab zab dang ra'i mtsho 'gram zhag tu bris/ rab rgyal bon gyi bstan pa rgyas byed shog/
